host_current.scope: Measurement cgroup and descendants: preparation, controller, private service and all sandboxes.
host_current.mean_method: Previous sample held until next sample; first-to-last sample only, including recorded gaps. Estimate, not a continuous integral.
host_current.interpretation: Charged group memory, not complete sandbox physical memory. Before-guest baseline includes prepared inputs and service; increases include subsequent control and service work. Peaks are sampled, final sample may be after guest deletion.
host_current.components: anon/file/kernel explain current; shmem is part of file. Counters are sequential and may lag: do not add them to current or label their residual unaccounted memory.

host_collector.scope: Fresh rollout slice: input preparation, controller, private service and all its descendants; host file includes shmem, not guest Cached.

task_check: strict outputs/exit codes/final files + original and second CSV input
cleanup: guest removed and collector reaped; private service/mount/loop removed; failed volume retained; source stopped
limits: current is cgroup-charged preparation/controller/service/sandbox memory; not complete physical coverage. No timing toggle or density control in this run.
